title: Synthetic fixture and discovery for Claude Code JSONL transcripts
description: Fixture mirrors the ~/.claude/projects layout (project dirs, session JSONL, subagent transcripts skipped). Done when: discovery finds sessions from the fixture with correct skip counts.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Synthetic Claude Code fixture + BDD: discovery finds one session per transcript, sidechain subagents skipped and counted (doctor reports 1 skipped subagent). ClaudeCodeSource::new(root) + discover() in src/adapters/claude_code.rs; fixture steps in tests/steps/claude_code_steps.rs. Full gate green (bdd 86/86, 0 skipped).

right_now_summary: A fixture mirrors Claude Code project data so discovery can find sessions and report skipped subagents.
